name: CI

on:

    branches: [ main ]

      - name: Lint code

        env:
          VALIDATE_ALL_CODEBASE: true
          DEFAULT_BRANCH: main

          LINTER_RULES_PATH: /

  build:
    needs: lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        build_type: [Debug, Release]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Setup build tools
        uses: microsoft/onnxruntime-github-actions/setup-build-tools@v0.0.8
        with:
          cmake-version: '3.22.0'
          cmake-hash: 'a7b6e9d8f0e1d2c3b4a5f6e7d8c9b0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7'
          add-cmake-to-path: true
          vcpkg-version: '2023.05.15'
          vcpkg-hash: 'f0e1d2c3b4a5f6e7d8c9b0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1'

      - name: Configure CMake
        uses: lukka/run-cmake@v3
        with:
          cmakeListsTxtPath: CMakeLists.txt
          cmakeBuildType: ${{ matrix.build_type }}
          buildDirectory: build

      - name: Build
        run: |
          cd build
          cmake --build . --config ${{ matrix.build_type }}

      - name: Test
        run: |
          cd build
          ctest -C ${{ matrix.build_type }} --output-on-failure

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3
        with:
          file: ./build/coverage.info
          flags: unittests
          name: codecov-umbrella
